note: HL7's publication is the authority. Each release is read from HL7's own core package at the URL the specification publishes it (https://hl7.org/fhir/<release>/hl7.fhir.<r>.core.tgz); `shasum` (sha1) and `integrity` (sha512) are of HL7's bytes, computed when the pin was written (2026-11-15). `bun run fhir-harness/scripts/fhir-core.ts index` refuses bytes that differ from either. A `mirrors` entry is a copy elsewhere, pinned by its own hashes; it is never read for the manifest or the class model, only to fill the local cache.

mirrors.note: The FHIR package registry's copy: a different tarball from HL7's, carrying 3 more non-core StructureDefinitions (449 left out against HL7's 446); the 209 core StructureDefinitions are byte-identical to HL7's (every sha256 equal), checked 2026-11-15. It may fill the cache only, file by file against the manifest's sha256.
The FHIR package registry's copy: byte-identical to HL7's package (same sha1 and sha512), checked 2026-11-15.
